-- Fix SKU-correlated whole-queue/materialized projection scans without changing draft semantics.
-- Keep the existing caller permissions, source freshness and latest-change ordering.
set local lock_timeout='5s';
set local statement_timeout='30s';
create index operations_hub_queue_active_projection_target_idx
on public.operations_hub_change_queue(source_channel,btrim(seller_product_code),seller_option_code_normalized)
where source_channel in ('smartstore','makeshop','ably')
and field_key in ('sellpia_current_stock','sellpia_sale_price')
and status in ('pending','validated','failed','processing');
create index operations_hub_legacy_projection_target_idx
on public.operations_hub_listing_legacy_cache(source_channel,btrim(product_code),(coalesce(nullif(btrim(option_code),''),'')));

create or replace view public.operations_hub_active_seller_drafts
with (security_invoker=true) as
WITH component_keys AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
select listing.source_channel,listing.product_code,coalesce(listing.option_code,'') as option_code,component.sellpia_sku_code
from public.operations_hub_seller_listings listing join public.operations_hub_listing_components component
on component.listing_id=listing.listing_id and component.is_active where listing.is_active
union all
select cache.source_channel,cache.product_code,cache.option_code,cache.sellpia_sku_code
from public.operations_hub_listing_legacy_cache cache
where not exists(select 1 from public.operations_hub_seller_listings explicit_listing
where explicit_listing.is_active and explicit_listing.source_channel=cache.source_channel
and explicit_listing.product_code=cache.product_code and explicit_listing.option_code=cache.option_code)
), active_queue AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
         SELECT queue.change_id,
            queue.sellpia_sku_code,
            queue.field_key,
            queue.before_value,
            queue.after_value,
            queue.target_channels,
            queue.status,
            queue.requested_by,
            queue.requested_at,
            queue.processed_at,
            queue.error_message,
            queue.source_channel,
            queue.seller_product_code,
            queue.seller_option_code,
            queue.change_batch_id,
            queue.validation_errors,
            queue.validated_at,
            queue.retry_count,
            queue.max_retry_count,
            queue.last_attempt_at,
            queue.next_retry_at,
            queue.cancelled_at,
            queue.cancelled_by,
            queue.status_message,
            queue.updated_at,
            queue.price_base_before,
            queue.price_base_after,
            queue.price_option_before,
            queue.price_option_after,
            queue.price_final_before,
            queue.price_final_after,
            queue.option_price_source,
            queue.price_rule_set_id,
            queue.price_discounted_base_before,
            queue.price_discounted_base_after,
            queue.price_calculation_version,
            queue.pricing_input_mode,
            queue.base_price_source,
            queue.source_snapshot_id,
            queue.source_discount_fingerprint,
            queue.price_discount_terms_before,
            queue.price_discount_terms_after,
            queue.seller_option_code_normalized,
            queue.target_component_skus,
            queue.target_safety_state,
            queue.target_safety_details
           FROM operations_hub_change_queue queue
          WHERE (queue.source_channel = ANY (ARRAY['smartstore'::text, 'makeshop'::text, 'ably'::text])) AND (queue.field_key = ANY (ARRAY['sellpia_current_stock'::text, 'sellpia_sale_price'::text])) AND (queue.status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'validated'::text, 'failed'::text, 'processing'::text]))
        ), projected AS (
         SELECT queue.change_id,
            queue.sellpia_sku_code,
            queue.field_key,
            queue.before_value,
            queue.after_value,
            queue.target_channels,
            queue.status,
            queue.requested_by,
            queue.requested_at,
            queue.processed_at,
            queue.error_message,
            queue.source_channel,
            queue.seller_product_code,
            queue.seller_option_code,
            queue.change_batch_id,
            queue.validation_errors,
            queue.validated_at,
            queue.retry_count,
            queue.max_retry_count,
            queue.last_attempt_at,
            queue.next_retry_at,
            queue.cancelled_at,
            queue.cancelled_by,
            queue.status_message,
            queue.updated_at,
            queue.price_base_before,
            queue.price_base_after,
            queue.price_option_before,
            queue.price_option_after,
            queue.price_final_before,
            queue.price_final_after,
            queue.option_price_source,
            queue.price_rule_set_id,
            queue.price_discounted_base_before,
            queue.price_discounted_base_after,
            queue.price_calculation_version,
            queue.pricing_input_mode,
            queue.base_price_source,
            queue.source_snapshot_id,
            queue.source_discount_fingerprint,
            queue.price_discount_terms_before,
            queue.price_discount_terms_after,
            queue.seller_option_code_normalized,
            queue.target_component_skus,
            queue.target_safety_state,
            queue.target_safety_details,
            component.sellpia_sku_code AS projected_sku
           FROM active_queue queue
             JOIN component_keys component ON component.source_channel = queue.source_channel AND btrim(component.product_code) = btrim(queue.seller_product_code) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(component.option_code), ''::text), ''::text) = queue.seller_option_code_normalized
        UNION ALL
         SELECT queue.change_id,
            queue.sellpia_sku_code,
            queue.field_key,
            queue.before_value,
            queue.after_value,
            queue.target_channels,
            queue.status,
            queue.requested_by,
            queue.requested_at,
            queue.processed_at,
            queue.error_message,
            queue.source_channel,
            queue.seller_product_code,
            queue.seller_option_code,
            queue.change_batch_id,
            queue.validation_errors,
            queue.validated_at,
            queue.retry_count,
            queue.max_retry_count,
            queue.last_attempt_at,
            queue.next_retry_at,
            queue.cancelled_at,
            queue.cancelled_by,
            queue.status_message,
            queue.updated_at,
            queue.price_base_before,
            queue.price_base_after,
            queue.price_option_before,
            queue.price_option_after,
            queue.price_final_before,
            queue.price_final_after,
            queue.option_price_source,
            queue.price_rule_set_id,
            queue.price_discounted_base_before,
            queue.price_discounted_base_after,
            queue.price_calculation_version,
            queue.pricing_input_mode,
            queue.base_price_source,
            queue.source_snapshot_id,
            queue.source_discount_fingerprint,
            queue.price_discount_terms_before,
            queue.price_discount_terms_after,
            queue.seller_option_code_normalized,
            queue.target_component_skus,
            queue.target_safety_state,
            queue.target_safety_details,
            queue.sellpia_sku_code AS projected_sku
           FROM active_queue queue
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM component_keys component
                  WHERE component.source_channel = queue.source_channel AND btrim(component.product_code) = btrim(queue.seller_product_code) AND COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(component.option_code), ''::text), ''::text) = queue.seller_option_code_normalized OFFSET 0))
        )
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (projected_sku, source_channel, field_key) change_id,
    projected_sku AS sellpia_sku_code,
    source_channel,
    field_key,
    before_value,
    after_value,
    status,
    updated_at,
    price_base_before,
    price_base_after,
    price_option_before,
    price_option_after,
    price_final_before,
    price_final_after,
    option_price_source,
    price_rule_set_id,
    price_discounted_base_before,
    price_discounted_base_after,
    base_price_source,
    price_calculation_version,
    pricing_input_mode,
    source_snapshot_id,
    source_discount_fingerprint,
    price_discount_terms_before,
    price_discount_terms_after
   FROM projected draft
  ORDER BY projected_sku, source_channel, field_key, updated_at DESC, change_id DESC;
notify pgrst,'reload schema';
